nodes.label: GitHub Clone and Cross-Repo Merge
nodes.rationale: graphify clone reuses existing clones under ~/.graphify/repos/<owner>/<repo>; merge-graphs combines multiple repos' graph.json files, tagging each node with a repo attribute.

nodes.label: Monorepo Multi-Subfolder Merge
nodes.rationale: Running the skill separately on each subfolder would clobber the same graphify-out/ dir, so the CLI is invoked directly per subfolder (graphify-out placed inside the scanned path) and merged afterward at the project root.
